cast.name: Creator
cast.description: Young Indian woman with curly hair in a blue top, filming selfie-style on a sunny balcony; warm, friendly, conversational female voice, mildly annoyed at the open then upbeat and reassuring.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Why does my skin always look so dull?

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Purple sits opposite yellow on the colour wheel.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: So it helps cancel yellow-looking dullness.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: And no, it doesn't stay purple.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: It blends clear on Indian skin, no white cast.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: With 4% Niacinamide, I get an Instant Glow and more even-looking skin, without changing my natural skin tone.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: And SPF 50 PA+++ keeps my daytime protection covered.
